title: Goals scene
description: One chart or finding packaged so it can render as a web chart, a PDF figure or a video segment without rework. A scene holds its data reference, a Vega-Lite spec, narration text timed into captions, and citations.

objective.description: Which of the three NSF objectives this scene supports.

url.description: Relative path to a CSV or JSON file in this repo.

chart.description: A Vega-Lite v5 spec. Its data.url resolves relative to the scene file.

narration.description: Spoken lines in order. Each becomes a caption cue; start and end are seconds from the scene start.

highlight.description: Optional field value to emphasize while this line plays.

aspect_ratios.description: Layouts the chart should be rendered at (landscape video, vertical social, square, feed).

alt_text.description: Text alternative for screen readers and PDF.
